Investment advice from Elon Musk:

Buy Low, Sell High.

One of my more recent size plays has actually been real life silver bars and coins

I’ve been accumulating a decent amount of physical silver over the past couple weeks and my average is sitting around $50.7 

I personally think silver has one of the best long term risk to reward opportunities in commodities rn and here’s why

A lot of people just look at silver as another precious metal like gold but don’t actually realize how important it is to the world (arguably the most important metal)

Silver has the highest electrical conductivity of any metal and is used in basically everything from electronics, solar panels, EVs, electrical infrastructure and even hardware used in AI/data centers (the future)

As technology continues advancing, the need for materials like silver isn’t just going to disappear, in fact with ev cars now stepping it up and potentially byd coming to America the demand and increase for silver is only gonna get bigger

Now the part that really interests me is the supply side and it’s what I have been telling family and friends

Silver has been running a supply deficit for 5 years straight with a 6th year projected for 2026

Basically more silver has been getting consumed than what’s being supplied through mining and recycling, and that difference has to come from existing inventories

On top of that, most silver isn’t even mined directly and it’s mostly produced as a byproduct of mining other metals like copper, zinc and lead

So even if silver starts moving up aggressively, it’s not like miners can just decide to double silver production overnight because the price went up

And unlike gold, a lot of silver is actually being used in industrial applications rather than just being stored away or women wearing fancy pretty jewelry 

Of course companies can find ways to use less silver when prices rise, but that doesn’t change how important the metal is especially at this price (-65% in a year aswell)

When you have something that’s genuinely needed across multiple industries, has limited short term supply flexibility and has been running deficits for years, I think it’s worth paying attention to and getting some exposure 

There’s also the investment side of it, If more capital starts flowing into physical silver while industrial demand remains strong, you’re adding another source of demand to an already tight market

I’m not saying silver is going straight up or that there won’t be corrections, but I personally really like the setup here and I think it’s a cool place to store cash 

I’m treating this as a long term position and plan on continuing to accumulate when I see good opportunities
